desc: Whether you're hunting hogs, varmint, or whitetail deer, you need to get on target fast. And few riflescopes let engage with as much speed as the Trijicon Credo HX. Its illuminated reticle gives you a crystal-clear aiming point, excellent light transmission allows for low light hunting, low capped adjusters and an extra-wide field of view offers maximum situational awareness. Includes Bikini caps, Scopecoat, 3mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide.
